scoring.primaryDomain: actual target choice sets, conditionally known; unobservable internal historical splits are never scored as observed
scoring.weights: equal observable groups within unit, equal units within case, equal election/horizon cases; electorate-weighted results are additional
pointScores: signed errors by observable group; do not interpret compositional cancellation as no bias
scoring.selection: Use only development scores. Seek a Pareto improvement on tails with adequate coverage; report tradeoffs if no candidate dominates. Never retune on later-election validation.

geography: Reduced samples are sampled-area/college diagnostics, not complete national forecasts. Full-domain validation is required before a national or college-wide claim. Municipal-to-current-college fractional reconstruction is labelled, with unmatched units counted.
reuse: These elections were already used in earlier research. Later-election validation is a separated comparison stage, not an untouched holdout.
failurePolicy: Retain every requested case/draw and technical or physical failure. No silent retry/target repair. Reduced computational gates precede full-country work.
